intro_en: Learn to explain an overslept, chaotic morning: alarms, sleep and rushing words. You'll use the Mongolian completive past perfect -чихсан байлаа (унтчихсан байлаа) and see how English separates "had been doing" from "had done."
intro_mn: Унтаж хэтэрсэн, бужигнасан өглөөгөө тайлбарлаж сурна: сэрүүлэг, нойр, яарахтай холбоотой үгс. Англи хэлний "had been doing" болон "had done" хэлбэрийн ялгааг ойлгож, монгол -чихсан байлаа хэлбэртэй харьцуулна.

vocab.example_en: The alarm went off at six.
I turned off my alarm and fell back asleep.
I was very sleepy this morning.

sentences.mn: Намайг сэрэхэд найман цаг болчихсон байлаа.
sentences.en: When I woke up, it was already eight o'clock.
alt_mn: Би сэрэхэд аль хэдийн найман цаг болчихсон байлаа.
alt_en: By the time I woke up, it was already eight.
When I woke up, it had already turned eight.
sentences.mn_latin: Namaig serekhed naiman tsag bolchikhson bailaa.

sentences.mn: Би сэрүүлгээ унтраагаад дахиад унтчихсан байлаа.
sentences.en: I had turned off my alarm and fallen back asleep.
alt_mn: Би сэрүүлгээ унтраачихаад буцаад унтчихсан байлаа.
alt_en: I'd turned off my alarm and gone back to sleep.
sentences.mn_latin: Bi serüülgee untraagaad dakhiad untchikhsan bailaa.

sentences.mn: Утасны минь цэнэг шөнөдөө дуусчихсан байлаа.
sentences.en: My phone battery had died during the night.
alt_mn: Шөнө утасны минь цэнэг дуусчихсан байлаа.
sentences.mn_latin: Utasny mini tseneg shönödöö duuschikhsan bailaa.

sentences.mn: Би бүтэн шөнө ажиллаж байсан болохоор өглөө унтаж хэтэрчихлээ.
sentences.en: I overslept this morning because I had been working all night.
alt_mn: Шөнөжин ажиллаж байсан болохоор би өглөө унтаж хэтэрчихсэн.
alt_en: I had been working all night, so I overslept this morning.
sentences.mn_latin: Bi büten shönö ajillaj baisan bolokhoor öglöö untaj kheterchikhlee.

sentences.mn: Би ердөө гурван цаг унтсан байсан болохоор их нойрмог байлаа.
sentences.en: I had only slept for three hours, so I was really sleepy.
alt_mn: Ердөө гурван цаг л унтсан байсан болохоор би их нойрмог байсан.
alt_en: I was very sleepy because I had only slept three hours.
sentences.mn_latin: Bi yerdöö gurvan tsag untsan baisan bolokhoor ikh noirmog bailaa.

sentences.mn: Би яарч гарахдаа түлхүүрээ гэртээ мартчихсан байлаа.
sentences.en: In my rush, I had left my keys at home.
alt_mn: Яарч гарахдаа би түлхүүрээ гэртээ орхичихсон байлаа.
alt_en: I had forgotten my keys at home in my rush.
Rushing out, I had left my keys at home.
sentences.mn_latin: Bi yaarch garakhdaa tülkhüüree gertee martchikhsan bailaa.

sentences.en: He had forgotten to set his alarm.
alt_en: She had forgotten to set her alarm.
He'd forgotten to set his alarm.

sentences.mn: Ээж намайг сэрээхэд би хоёр цаг гаруй унтаж хэтэрчихсэн байлаа.
sentences.en: When my mom woke me up, I had overslept by more than two hours.
alt_en: By the time my mom woke me, I had overslept by over two hours.
sentences.mn_latin: Eej namaig sereekhed bi khoyor tsag garui untaj kheterchikhsen bailaa.

sentences.mn: Би тэвдээд цамцаа урвуу өмсчихсөн байлаа.
sentences.en: I had panicked and put my shirt on inside out.
alt_en: In my panic, I had put my shirt on inside out.
sentences.mn_latin: Bi tevdeed tsamtsaa urvuu ömschikhsön bailaa.

sentences.mn: Намайг гал тогоонд ороход кофе минь аль хэдийн хөрчихсөн байлаа.
sentences.en: By the time I got to the kitchen, my coffee had already gone cold.
alt_en: When I went into the kitchen, my coffee had already gotten cold.
sentences.mn_latin: Namaig gal togoond orokhod kofye mini ali khediin khörchikhsön bailaa.

sentences.mn: Би сэрүүлгээ гурван удаа хойшлуулчихсан байлаа.
sentences.en: I had hit snooze three times.
alt_en: I had snoozed my alarm three times.
sentences.mn_latin: Bi serüülgee gurvan udaa khoishluulchikhsan bailaa.

sentences.mn: Түүнийг ажилдаа ирэхэд хурал эхэлчихсэн байлаа.
sentences.en: When she got to work, the meeting had already started.
alt_mn: Түүнийг ажил дээрээ ирэхэд хурал аль хэдийн эхэлчихсэн байлаа.
alt_en: By the time he got to work, the meeting had already started.
sentences.mn_latin: Tüüniig ajildaa irekhed khural ekhelchikhsen bailaa.

grammar.title_mn: Past perfect continuous ба past perfect simple
grammar.explain_en: To say something had already happened before another past moment, Mongolian uses the past participle -сан/-сэн/-сон/-сөн + байлаа ("had done"). Add the completive suffix -чих- before it (унт- → унтчихсан байлаа) and the action sounds fully finished, often unintended or regrettable: "I had gone and fallen asleep!" It's very common in speech when explaining mishaps. The vowel after -чих- follows the verb root: болчихсон, хөрчихсөн, эхэлчихсэн, мартчихсан. A plain clause with -хад ("when...") usually sets the reference moment: Намайг сэрэхэд... (When I woke up...). For a longer ongoing action before that moment, use -ж байсан: ажиллаж байсан ("had been working").
grammar.explain_mn: Англи хэлэнд өнгөрсөн нэг мөчөөс өмнө болсон үйлийг хоёр янзаар хэлнэ. Past perfect simple (had + V3) — үйл дуусч, үр дүн нь гарсныг заана: "I had turned off my alarm" (сэрүүлгээ унтраачихсан байсан). Past perfect continuous (had been + -ing) — тухайн мөч хүртэл үргэлжилсэн, удаан хугацааны үйлийг заана, ихэвчлэн шалтгаан болгон хэрэглэнэ: "I had been working all night, so I overslept" (шөнөжин ажиллаж байсан). Хугацааг for/since-ээр хэлэхэд continuous хэлбэр түгээмэл: "I had been sleeping for ten hours." Харин хэдэн удаа хийснийг тоолбол simple хэлбэр: "I had hit snooze three times."

examples.en: When I woke up, the bus had already left.

examples.mn: Би шөнөжин хичээл хийж байсан болохоор унтаж хэтэрчихсэн.
examples.en: I had been studying all night, so I overslept.
examples.mn_latin: Bi shönöjin khicheel khiij baisan bolokhoor untaj kheterchikhsen.

examples.mn: Тэр арван цаг унтсан байсан ч нойрмог хэвээр байлаа.
examples.en: He had slept for ten hours, but he was still sleepy.
examples.mn_latin: Ter arvan tsag untsan baisan ch noirmog kheveer bailaa.

fill_blank.text: Намайг сэрэхэд найман цаг бол___ байлаа.
fill_blank.translation: When I woke up, it was already eight o'clock.
fill_blank.explain_en: The root бол- has the vowel о, so the participle after -чих- takes -сон: болчихсон.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Үгийн язгуур "бол-" о эгшигтэй тул эгшиг зохицох ёсоор -чихсон болно.

fill_blank.translation: I had forgotten to set my alarm.
fill_blank.explain_en: "Forget to do something" uses the future participle -х + reflexive accusative -аа: тавихаа мартах.
fill_blank.explain_mn: "Хийхээ мартах" бүтэц: -х үйлт нэр + заахын тийн ялгалын ерөнхий хамаатуулах -аа. "Тавихаа мартчихсан" гэнэ.

fill_blank.translation: My phone battery had died during the night.
fill_blank.explain_en: -чихсан + байлаа closes the sentence as a past perfect: "had (already) died." The other forms can't end a sentence here.
fill_blank.explain_mn: "-чихсан байлаа" нь өгүүлбэрийг төгсгөж, өнгөрсөн мөчөөс өмнө бүрэн дууссан үйлийг заана. Бусад хэлбэр нь өгүүлбэр төгсгөхгүй.

fill_blank.text: I ___ been working all night, so I overslept.
fill_blank.translation: Би шөнөжин ажиллаж байсан болохоор унтаж хэтэрчихсэн.
fill_blank.explain_en: The working happened before the past event (oversleeping), so we need the past perfect continuous: had been + -ing.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Ажилласан нь унтаж хэтэрснээс өмнө үргэлжилж байсан тул past perfect continuous: had been + -ing хэрэглэнэ.

fill_blank.text: By the time I woke up, the meeting had already ___.
fill_blank.translation: Намайг сэрэхэд хурал аль хэдийн эхэлчихсэн байлаа.
fill_blank.explain_en: Starting is a single completed event, so use past perfect simple: had + past participle (started).
fill_blank.explain_mn: Хурал эхлэх нь нэг удаагийн, дууссан үйл тул had + V3 (started) буюу past perfect simple хэрэглэнэ.

fill_blank.text: She was exhausted because she had been ___ for her exams all week.
fill_blank.translation: Тэр бүтэн долоо хоногийн турш шалгалтдаа бэлдэж байсан болохоор маш их ядарсан байлаа.
fill_blank.explain_en: After "had been" we need the -ing form; "all week" shows a long, ongoing activity that caused her tiredness.
fill_blank.explain_mn: "had been"-ийн дараа үйл үг -ing хэлбэртэй байна. "All week" нь удаан үргэлжилсэн үйлийг заадаг.

dialogue.speaker: Tuvshin
dialogue.mn: Болор, юу болов? Хурал аль хэдийн эхэлчихсэн байсан шүү.
dialogue.en: Bolor, what happened? The meeting had already started.
dialogue.mn_latin: Bolor, yuu bolov? Khural ali khediin ekhelchikhsen baisan shüü.

dialogue.speaker: Bolor
dialogue.mn: Уучлаарай, сэрүүлэг минь дуугараагүй. Утасны цэнэг шөнөдөө дуусчихсан байлаа.
dialogue.en: Sorry, my alarm didn't go off. My phone had died during the night.
dialogue.mn_latin: Uuchlaarai, serüüleg mini duugaraagüi. Utasny tseneg shönödöö duuschikhsan bailaa.

dialogue.speaker: Tuvshin
dialogue.en: Didn't you plug in your charger?

dialogue.speaker: Bolor
dialogue.mn: Залгасан гэж бодсон юм. Өчигдөр орой болтол тайлан бичиж байсан болохоор их ядарчихсан байсан.
dialogue.en: I thought I had. I had been writing the report until late last night, so I was exhausted.
dialogue.mn_latin: Zalgasan gej bodson yum. Öchigdör oroi boltol tailan bichij baisan bolokhoor ikh yadarchikhsan baisan.

dialogue.speaker: Tuvshin
dialogue.en: I see. So how did you get here?

dialogue.speaker: Bolor
dialogue.mn: Найман цагт сэрээд тэвдчихлээ. Цайгаа ч уулгүй, таксигаар яарч ирлээ.
dialogue.en: I woke up at eight and panicked. I didn't even have my tea; I rushed over by taxi.
dialogue.mn_latin: Naiman tsagt sereed tevdchikhlee. Tsaigaa ch uulgüi, taksigaar yaarch irlee.

dialogue.speaker: Bolor
dialogue.en: Yes, I'll start doing that tomorrow.

culture_note.en: Ulaanbaatar winter mornings are dark and often below −30°C, so getting out of a warm bed is a real struggle. In ger districts, someone usually has to wake up early to light the stove before the family gets up. Add the city's heavy morning traffic, and oversleeping by even 15 minutes can make you an hour late. That's why "Унтаж хэтэрчихлээ" (I overslept) is such a familiar, half-forgiven excuse.
culture_note.mn: Улаанбаатарын өвлийн өглөө харанхуй, ихэвчлэн −30 хэмээс хүйтэн байдаг тул дулаан орноосоо босох амаргүй. Гэр хороололд гэр бүлийнхнээ босохоос өмнө хэн нэг нь эрт босч зуухаа галладаг. Үүн дээр өглөөний түгжрэл нэмэгдэхээр 15 минут унтаж хэтэрсэн ч нэг цаг хоцорч болно. Тиймээс "Унтаж хэтэрчихлээ" гэдэг нь хүмүүсийн сайн мэддэг, бараг уучлагддаг шалтаг юм.

review.notes: A solid, natural lesson with correct vowel harmony. The fixes are one ambiguous fill-in option, one case-government slip and one mistranslated time phrase.

opus_fix.notes: The lesson is in very good shape. The grammar section deliberately explains Mongolian in en and English in mn, so I kept that design.

changes.why: The ending -аа here is the accusative reflexive form. The mn text called it only possessive, which does not match the en explanation.
